Maria Diaz: noticing a big spike in retries from our python-sdk apps hitting staging for a deployment test — everything retries in lockstep and causes 503 cascades. anyone else?
Ben Cooper: hmmm. are these the default backoff settings (exp backoff without jitter) or custom? can you paste a repro?
Maria Diaz: default SDK 0.8.4 settings. repro script attached below. short script just fires 60 concurrent requests with a stubbed 503 from staging env.
Maria Diaz: ```python
import concurrent.futures, requests
URL = 'https://staging-api.redwood-inference.internal/gen'
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(60) as ex:
    futures = [ex.submit(lambda i: requests.post(URL, headers={'x-idempotency-key':f'demo-{i}'}, timeout=5), i) for i in range(60)]
    for f in futures: f.result()
```
Maria Diaz: observed logs show retries at 1s,2s,4s,8s all aligned. no jitter.
Tomo Saito: thanks — there is a bug in the async client where jitter flag defaults to False after session reuse; sync client looks like it may have the same issue. filing bug.
Tomo Saito: workaround: set SDK retry config `enable_jitter: true` explicitly; we'll push a patch to default to decorrelated jitter.
Ben Cooper: can you open a minimal GH reproducer? also we should add per-request backoff overrides (short ttl for idempotent ops) and an opt-in global backoff policy via env var.
Kevin O'Neill: ops note: we should also emit an alert when we see a retry_cascade pattern (many clients hit 5xx then simultaneous retries). low overhead metric idea: count distinct source IPs * retry attempts within 10s.
Maria Diaz: filed an issue #4321 with repro and logs, attached the sample script + k8s svc logs. thanks all :thumbsup:
ci-bot: deploy-notice: canary(eng-runtime) rolled out build 2026.3.1 to staging
Ben Cooper: i'll pick up the SDK patch and add unit tests for jitter + session reuse. will also add an integration test that simulates aligned 503s.
Maria Diaz: great — will validate with the reproducer and report back :eyes:
